# From the system notes

After a Cursor plugin install, the short command loop is [plugins/crav1/README.md](../plugins/crav1/README.md).

Use this when **system notes already exist** under `docs/system/` and you want them read back.

A question about one feature, slice, resource, or not-yet-feature is [what's known about](from-what-do-we-know-about-this.md) (`/crav1-what-do-we-know-about-this`). This command reads `docs/system/`. When the picture has nothing on the question, it quotes the first paragraph of the matching slice's spec, labelled as coming from the spec, and names `/crav1-what-do-we-know-about-this`.

Ask whether the system can do something: yes points at the note that says yes, no points at the note that says no, and a thing the notes never mention is not written down.

On every run this command compares the feature index with two places: the slice's node in `docs/system/diagrams.md`, and its line under `## How the parts connect`. The update is [keep current](from-refresh-system-notes.md) (`/crav1-refresh-system-notes`).

## First prompt

```text
/crav1-explain-existing-system
@docs/system/
```

```text
/crav1-explain-existing-system
@docs/system/diagrams.md
```

```text
/crav1-explain-existing-system

Can the system do <the thing>?
```

## Steps

| Phase | You | Agent |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Notes | — | Stops when `docs/system/` has no notes yet. Points at spark, ideas, intake, match, or existing-to-specs when the user named repos and brought no dump. Does not invent the notes |
| Answer | Read the TLDR | A few sentences from the short description, or from the part you named |
| Longer | Say longer | One level deeper from the same notes. The next longer opens one more heading. Stops when the notes have no further level |
| Can it | Ask the question | Yes and where, no and where, or that is not written down |
| Nothing in the picture | — | Quotes the first paragraph of the matching spec, labelled `From the spec`, and names `/crav1-what-do-we-know-about-this`. When no spec matches, says so and names that skill. Does not run it |
| Feature index | — | One line per slice missing a diagram node, a connection line, or both. Includes done and retired, with status. Names `/crav1-refresh-system-notes`. Does not run it |

## What gets written

No `plan.md`. No `tasks.md`. A missing `docs/system/` is not seeded here.

## After

```text
/crav1-refresh-system-notes
```

Reference page: [explain](reference/skills/crav1-explain-existing-system.md)

The run ends as [How a run ends](reference/run-ending.md) says: Run next, never a `Next:` line, `Waiting:` only when a step is blocked, and `Uncommitted:` when files changed and are not committed.
